caption: Without the 13th cheque I'd have been R3 850 short. Do you also spend the bonus before it lands?

slides.title:
Where my R29 600
went the month my
13th cheque landed
Living in Vredendal
slides.body:
Female, 53
Married, son (26) back home looking for work
Job: Finance clerk, local municipality
Net income: R29 600 p/m (this month, includes a R9 000 13th cheque)

slides.title: Christmas stock-up
slides.includes: Meat, drinks, the big tin of biscuits, the family lunch
slides.body: Eleven people on the 25th. I've done this for thirty years and I still undercount.

slides.title: Gifts & 'treats'
slides.includes: An air fryer, a TV on special, presents for six grandchildren
slides.body: The air fryer was R1 800. I have a working oven. I won't be taking questions.

slides.title: Medical aid
slides.includes: Me and my husband, the hospital plan
slides.body: It goes up every January and every January I am surprised.

slides.title: Black tax
slides.includes: My sister's three children's school fees, groceries for my aunt
slides.body: My sister works on the farms. In December there's no work. So it's more in December.

slides.title: Car
slides.includes: A service and two new tyres
slides.body: The tyres were not optional. The service was a bit optional.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Petrol, electricity, funeral policy, Christmas stokvel, phone, church
slides.body: The stokvel is R1 500 a month. It pays out next month and I'm already spending it too.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R29 600. My normal month is R20 600. So without the bonus I'd be R3 850 short.

slides.title: I wanted to see where it went
slides.body:
I uploaded my statement to Beyond Horizon and it sorted every transaction.

The 'treats' category was a surprise.

No bank login needed.
